entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'm calling about an order I placed a while back. I have a cycling jersey that I need to return.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Sam Jones, and the order number is VF789012.
Thank you, Sam. I have your order right here. I see the VeloFit Aero Jersey, purchased about 80 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
It's simply the wrong size. I tried it on once when I got it and realized it's just too tight for a comfortable ride. I was hoping to do an exchange for a larger size.
I understand completely. Let me just check our return policy for you. One moment.

Okay, thanks for your patience. I've confirmed that standard apparel items like this jersey are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at day 80, you are well within that window. I can absolutely approve this return for you.

That's great news. Now, since I do plan to buy the correct size, and there's a bit of hassle involved in shipping this one back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase?

That's a reasonable question. While our system doesn't allow me to generate a goodwill discount for a standard size exchange, I can confirm the return shipping is completely on us. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. You can just print it, attach it to the package, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll process a full refund to your original payment method.
Alright, a full refund and free return shipping is fair enough. I appreciate you making the process straightforward.
Of course, Sam. We want to make sure you get the gear that fits you perfectly. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. Have a great day and enjoy your rides!
